materials.title: Procedure Text
materials.content:
## What is a procedure text?

A procedure text is a text that gives instructions for doing a particular activity. It can also serve to explain how something works. It aims to give instruction or to explain how something can be done. It uses imperative and consists of goal or purpose, may or may not contain materials, and steps.

### Structure

| Part | Function | Example |
|---|---|---|
| Goal or purpose | States what the reader will do or achieve | How to stay healthy as a student |
| Materials (optional) | Lists the things needed | A pair of running shoes, a water bottle |
| Steps | Gives ordered instructions | First, exercise for 30 minutes. Then, drink enough water. |

### Language features

- Imperative sentences begin with a verb: Eat healthy food. Get eight hours of sleep.
- Action verbs name the activity: exercise, brush, drink, avoid.
- Sequence words show the order: first, next, then, after that, finally.
- Adverbs tell how or how often: regularly, daily, slowly, carefully.

A procedure text is judged by whether the reader can follow the steps and reach the goal without asking extra questions.

materials.title: Reading: Health Tips and Self-care
materials.content:
## Everyday health habits

A class survey lists habits that support health: exercise, eat healthy foods, check your weight, get eight hours of sleep, brush and floss your teeth, and wear sunscreen when you go outside. Self-care means to practise things including hygiene and nutrition to keep yourself physically and mentally healthy.

### Mental health tips

1. Engross yourself shortly with what is around you.
1. Remind yourself that some things can go wrong.
1. Mind your bodily well-being.
1. Talk about your problem with someone you trust.
1. Convince yourself that by the end of the day everything is going to be fine.

### Habits for weight loss

1. Avoid a sedentary lifestyle and begin to move around.
1. Do not miss your morning meals.
1. Drink water first thing when you get up from sleep.
1. Keep enough gap between your dinner and your sleep.
1. Do not take a big portion for your lunch.

| Mental health | Physical health |
|---|---|
| Talk to someone you trust | Exercise regularly |
| Accept that some things can go wrong | Eat healthy foods |
| Mind your bodily well-being | Get eight hours of sleep |
| Convince yourself things will be fine | Wear sunscreen outside |

terms.definition: Practising things such as hygiene and nutrition to keep yourself physically and mentally healthy.
The condition of your mind and emotions.
A way of life with little physical movement.
A substance in food that the body needs to stay healthy.
A product that protects the skin from sunlight.

materials.title: Writing Health Tips and a Campaign
materials.content:
## Plan your procedure text

Before writing, decide which aspect of health you will write about and who your readers are. Then fill in an organizer with a title, a purpose, and the steps. The purpose should be written in clear sentences, and the steps must be in the correct order.

| Part of organizer | Question to answer |
|---|---|
| Title | What is the text about? |
| Purpose | What will the reader achieve? |
| Steps | What should the reader do first, next, and finally? |

### Steps to write

1. Choose the health aspect and the target reader.
1. Collect enough sources to support your tips.
1. Write the title and the purpose.
1. List the steps in the correct order using imperatives.
1. Do a peer review.
1. Revise and publish the text, for example as an infographic.

### Peer review checklist

| Aspect | Question |
|---|---|
| Title | Do you write the text title? |
| Purpose | Is your purpose written in clear sentences? |
| Steps | Are your steps clear and in the correct order? |
| Sentences | Are your sentences complete and easy to understand? |
| Mechanics | Are the spelling and punctuation correct? |
| Length | Is the text between 100 and 200 words? |
| Multimodal | Does the text use another mode, for example a picture? |

### Health campaign poster

- Choose the aspect of health you want to promote.
- Identify your target audience.
- Check that your sources support the campaign message.
- Use text, image, layout, and font to present the message clearly.
- Make sure the poster is free of spelling mistakes.
- Publish the poster to the media of your choice.

nodes.text: A classmate says, "I can't keep my eyes open in morning classes." What advice do you give?

choices.text: Suggest getting eight hours of sleep and keeping a regular bedtime
choices.feedback: Kurang tidur adalah penyebab umum kantuk di kelas; sarannya sesuai dan dapat dilakukan.

choices.text: Tell them to drink more coffee every morning
choices.feedback: Kopi hanya menutupi gejala dan tidak memperbaiki kebiasaan tidur.

choices.text: Say it is not a health problem
choices.feedback: Kantuk berlebihan dapat mengganggu belajar dan perlu ditangani.

nodes.text: Your classmate also says they often skip breakfast. What do you suggest?

choices.text: Do not miss morning meals and choose healthy food
choices.feedback: Sarapan membantu energi dan konsentrasi; sarannya sesuai kebiasaan sehat.

choices.text: Skip lunch instead to balance the calories
choices.feedback: Melewatkan makan lagi memperburuk pola makan.

nodes.text: A week later your classmate still feels sleepy. What do you do?

choices.text: Review the sleep habit and suggest talking to a trusted adult or doctor
choices.feedback: Mencari bantuan yang tepat lebih baik daripada terus memberi solusi yang sama.

choices.text: Tell them to drink even more coffee
choices.feedback: Menambah kopi tidak menyelesaikan penyebab masalah.

nodes.text: Your classmate asks why sleep matters. What do you say?

choices.text: Sleep helps the body recover and the mind concentrate
choices.feedback: Penjelasan yang benar membantu teman memahami alasan di balik saran.

choices.text: Sleep is only for young children
choices.feedback: Remaja juga membutuhkan tidur yang cukup.

nodes.text: Your friend now has a clear, realistic plan for sleep and breakfast.
Skipping another meal makes the problem worse instead of balancing it.
The advice is adjusted and professional help is considered when needed.
The real cause is ignored, so the problem continues.

items.question: Ubah menjadi imperatif: "You should drink water." → … water.
Ubah menjadi imperatif: "You should eat healthy food." → … healthy food.
Ubah menjadi imperatif: "You should not skip breakfast." → … skip breakfast.

feedback.correct: Tepat. Imperatif dimulai dengan kata kerja, dan kata urutan membantu pembaca mengikuti langkah.
feedback.wrong: Ingat pola imperatif: kata kerja dasar di awal kalimat, tanpa subjek.

blocks.question: A peer reviewer says your steps are out of order. What should you do?

choices.text: Reorder the steps so the reader can follow them
Add more adjectives to the title
Delete the purpose sentence

blocks.explanation: Teks prosedur harus berurutan; memperbaiki urutan adalah prioritas utama.

questions.question: A procedure text gives …
questions.explanation: Teks prosedur memberi petunjuk melakukan suatu aktivitas.

questions.question: Which part states what the reader will achieve?
questions.explanation: Goal atau purpose menyatakan tujuan yang akan dicapai pembaca.

questions.question: Which sentence is an imperative?

options.text: I get eight hours of sleep.

questions.explanation: Imperatif dimulai dengan kata kerja perintah, yaitu "Get".

questions.question: What does "self-care" include?
questions.explanation: Self-care mencakup kebiasaan seperti kebersihan dan gizi untuk menjaga kesehatan fisik dan mental.

questions.question: How many hours of sleep does the survey mention?
questions.explanation: Daftar kebiasaan sehat menyebut "get 8 hours of sleep".

questions.question: Which part may or may not be present in a procedure text?
questions.explanation: Teks prosedur selalu punya tujuan dan langkah; materials bersifat opsional.

questions.question: Which word shows the order of steps?
questions.explanation: Then adalah kata urutan; because, although, dan however menunjukkan sebab atau pertentangan.

questions.question: What should you do first thing in the morning to support weight loss?
questions.explanation: Kebiasaan yang dianjurkan adalah minum air putih setelah bangun tidur.

questions.question: Which habit helps mental health?

options.text: Talking about your problem with someone you trust

questions.explanation: Berbagi masalah dengan orang yang dipercaya adalah tips kesehatan mental dalam teks.

questions.question: Why is a sedentary lifestyle unhealthy?

options.text: It involves too little physical movement.
It means eating too many vegetables.

questions.explanation: Sedentary lifestyle berarti gaya hidup dengan sedikit gerak, sehingga dianjurkan untuk bergerak.

questions.question: What makes a procedure text easy to follow?

options.text: Clear steps in the correct order

questions.explanation: Langkah yang jelas dan berurutan adalah inti teks prosedur.

questions.question: Which sentence uses an imperative correctly?

options.text: Avoiding a sedentary lifestyle is good.

questions.explanation: Imperatif memakai kata kerja dasar di awal: Avoid.

questions.question: Which habits are mentioned in the health survey? Choose all that apply.
questions.explanation: Survei menyebut olahraga, makan sehat, dan tabir surya; melewatkan sarapan bukan kebiasaan sehat.

questions.question: Match each part of a procedure text with its function.
questions.explanation: Setiap bagian punya fungsi berbeda dalam membangun teks prosedur.

questions.question: Put the health text-writing steps in order.
questions.explanation: Topik → tujuan → langkah → tinjauan teman.

questions.question: Why should a procedure text use imperatives?

options.text: They directly tell the reader what to do.

questions.explanation: Imperatif memberi perintah langsung sehingga pembaca tahu tindakan yang harus dilakukan.

questions.question: What can you infer about a person who often skips breakfast and sleeps late?

options.text: Their daily habits may affect their energy and concentration.

questions.explanation: Kebiasaan makan dan tidur memengaruhi energi serta konsentrasi, sesuai tips kesehatan dalam teks.

questions.question: Which sentence best states the purpose of a text titled "How to Stay Healthy as a Student"?

options.text: This text explains how students can build healthy daily habits.
I was a healthy student last year.

questions.explanation: Pernyataan tujuan harus menjelaskan apa yang akan dicapai pembaca, bukan menceritakan pengalaman.

questions.question: Which detail supports the idea that self-care includes prevention?
questions.explanation: Tabir surya mencegah kerusakan kulit, sehingga termasuk perawatan preventif.

questions.question: What is the effect of adding "first, next, then, finally" to the steps?

options.text: The reader can follow the order clearly.

questions.explanation: Kata urutan menunjukkan urutan langkah sehingga teks mudah diikuti.

questions.question: Why is the materials section optional in a procedure text?

options.text: Some activities do not need special tools or ingredients.

questions.explanation: Aktivitas seperti berolahraga ringan mungkin tidak memerlukan bahan khusus, sehingga bagian materials boleh tidak ada.

questions.question: Which comment is the most useful peer review for a procedure text?

options.text: Your second and third steps are swapped; reorder them.
I like the colour of your paper.
You should write about something else.

questions.explanation: Umpan balik yang berguna menunjukkan masalah konkret dan cara memperbaikinya.

questions.question: What is the best way to conclude a procedure text about staying healthy?

options.text: State the result or a short encouraging closing related to the goal

questions.explanation: Penutup yang baik mengaitkan langkah dengan tujuan, bukan membuka topik baru.

questions.question: Which statement about health campaigns is supported by the text?

options.text: A poster should use text, image, layout, and font effectively.
A poster should hide its target audience.
A poster must be written in one long paragraph.

questions.explanation: Teks menekankan penggunaan teks, gambar, tata letak, dan font yang baik, serta sumber yang mendukung pesan.

questions.question: What can you infer about the relationship between self-care and caring for others?

options.text: People who care for themselves are better able to care for others.
Caring for others means ignoring yourself.
Self-care and caring for others cannot coexist.

questions.explanation: Teks menyebut bahwa setelah cukup merawat diri, seseorang mampu merawat orang lain.

questions.question: Which revision makes a step clearer?

options.text: Drink a glass of water after you wake up.
Drinking is a thing people do.

questions.explanation: Langkah yang jelas memakai kata kerja imperatif dan rincian yang dapat langsung diikuti.

questions.question: Which sentence uses the correct punctuation for an imperative list?

options.text: First, exercise. Next, drink water. Finally, sleep early.
First exercise next drink water finally sleep early
First, exercise, next, drink water, finally, sleep early,
first exercise; Next drink water; finally sleep early

questions.explanation: Setiap langkah adalah kalimat terpisah; kata urutan diikuti koma dan diakhiri titik.

questions.question: Why does a health campaign need a clear target audience?

options.text: The message and design can be adjusted to the people it addresses.
So the poster can be as long as possible
So the writer can avoid research
So the poster needs no images

questions.explanation: Mengetahui audiens membantu memilih pesan, gambar, dan gaya bahasa yang tepat.

questions.question: Which are language features of a procedure text? Choose all that apply.
questions.explanation: Imperatif, kata kerja aksi, dan kata urutan adalah ciri prosedur; cerita pribadi milik recount.

questions.question: Arrange the steps of producing a health poster.
questions.explanation: Topik → audiens → sketsa → pemeriksaan → publikasi.
